- [AI Visibility Audit](https://mayamate.com/products/ai-visibility-audit/): When someone asks ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google's AI who to buy from in your category, who gets named — and why isn't it you? Verbatim answers, a scoreboard and a prioritized fix list. $49 for my first ten customers.
- [Sample AI Visibility Audit](https://mayamate.com/products/sample-audit/): A real audit, rendered from real answers — only the client is made up. This is exactly what you get for $49.
